text:
maria: CI red on nightly-quant: L40 job failing during quantized compile step for llm/llama-70b q4_k_t. Build 2027. Commit f3a9c2e. Error shows invalid device function then cuMemAlloc OOM. Pinging eng-ml. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2027

sam: can you paste the error snippet? rerun helps sometimes.

maria: pasted logs below — main failure during kernel link/launch:
```
[quant_compile] ERROR: invalid device function: kernel=quantize_kv, ptx=sm_86
E cuMemAlloc: out of memory allocating 2.1GB
stack: cudaLaunchKernel -> quantize_kv -> kv_pack -> ...
```
Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/2027/artifacts/quant.log

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @sam: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2027/retry (job id 98765). Uploads: s3://redwood-ci/2027/retry-98765/logs/

leo: looks suspiciously like a driver/PTX mismatch on L40. Our L40 nodes expect sm_80 kernels; logs show sm_86. Did infra roll a newer CUDA toolchain or driver? cc @devops-bot @tara

tara: infra rolled nvidia driver 535.xx and a CUDA toolchain bump yesterday to the L40 fleet (image ami-0abc123) — timestamped 2026-03-15 03:12 UTC. Rolling back is non-trivial. Can repro if someone grants me a non-upgraded L40.

devops-bot: Node image update recorded: ami-0abc123, kernel 6.1, driver 535.102. Queue: 3 nodes in updated pool (l40-rt).

maria: request: can someone bisect commits between f0a1c..f3a9c2e? Suspect PR #542 (quant kernel change) or #550 small opt. Also please run a rerun on a legacy L40 (pre-driver bump) to see if it's infra or code.

leo: I can bisect; need a narrowed range. Is PR #542 the major quant change? @maria

maria: PR #542 + tiny follow-up in #550. Try range f0a1c4..f3a9c2e. Build logs and compile flags attached in artifact.

leo: starting git bisect against that range locally, will use the reproducer compile script from s3. Will post commit that first fails.

sam: tagging @oncall-eng-ml for faster allocation of a legacy L40 node :rotating_light:

leo: quick update — bisect points to commit f2b7d8 (the quant kernel signature change in PR #542). Repro build fails with same invalid-device-function when compiled with our current toolchain.

tara: allocating l40-legacy-03 now and kicking the job with the bisect artifact. I will post console link when done.

oncall-eng-ml: Allocated node l40-legacy-03, IP x.x.x.x. Job submitted: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2027/legacy-run (job id 98801).

maria: thanks everyone. If bisect reproduces, immediate mitigation: pin nodes to previous driver or compile a PTX-compatible fallback. Plan: revert infra driver on a canary pool and open rollback playbook. Keep this thread for updates.

leo: will upload minimal repro (compile + run) to s3 and file an urgent PR with a conditional kernel fallback if needed.

maria: assign follow-ups: @leo bisect & PR, @tara run legacy validation, @devops-bot review rollback options. I'll open an incident if canary rollback is needed.

sam: thanks — ping me when the canary run completes, I'll help shepherd the rollback if we need it. :thumbsup:
